'''Tao-Ni Security''' was a security and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tao-Ni Security appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tao-Ni Security was added to the game along with the "[[W:c:swg:IG-88|IG-88]] heroic encounter", released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" update on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
